mode_selection: Cell strain: a compatible xz shear in the degenerate pcu nullspace; the unique symmetry-preserving cco null strain.
internal_relaxation: w = -(K_ww - t H_ww)^(-1) (K_we - t H_we) e at the PD threshold; all translations and rotations retained.
supercell_note: 3x3x3 pcu and 2x2x2 cco for block views; finite-k net uses the smallest commensurate rectangular supercell.
units: Cartesian lengths in units of mean parent strut length; pressure/E_s with E_s=1; k in fractional reciprocal coordinates of unit_cell.
geometry_note: Each edge is one of two FE segments per parent strut. edges=[i,j,sx,sy,sz]; draw from positions[i] to positions[j]+[sx,sy,sz]@cell. Unwrapped endpoints and Hermite centerlines are provided explicitly to avoid long wraparound chords.
displacement_note: Translations include both affine strain and relaxed internal translations. At an image endpoint add (image@cell)@macro_strain.T; rotations repeat over the supercell. Finite-k field is the real part and has zero macro_strain. Hermite centerline samples also use the recovered rotations.
normalization: max Euclidean norm of stored node translations=1, independently for each net. Same multiplier applied to rotations and macro_strain. A global rigid translation is removed; illustrative amplitude and sign are arbitrary.
energy_note: Positive elastic bending/stretching/torsion energy 0.5*u_e^T*K_e*u_e of the real mode, normalized by its maximum across elements. This is not the vanishing signed Gibbs tangent energy at onset. Colors are normalized separately per net.
